During a restless phase, a short confusion involving kennel doors

Aurelia Skyways Companion Animal Travel Desk incident report

During a restless phase, a short confusion involving kennel doors affected routine check-in support for two travelers and a pet. The desk kept a calm and welcoming tone while the issue was noticed, and the senior coordinator was told at once. Staff checked the kennel latches, confirmed that no animal had left secure control, and guided the travelers to step back while the area was made safe. One pet, Penny, was watched closely and remained stable after the doors were reset. The travelers were given clear, plain instructions on how the kennel should be handled and what to expect next. Staff also reviewed the travel documents to make sure the booking still matched the animal care notes. The senior coordinator decided that the kennel could continue in service after a final inspection, and the desk confirmed the condition to the travelers in a reassuring manner. A follow-up note was entered for later review so the team can prevent a repeat and keep future companion animal travel smooth and orderly.
